title: FITS (Flexible Image Transport System) signature
summary: A FITS file begins with the 80-byte ASCII string 'SIMPLE  =                    T' (the SIMPLE keyword card) or 'XTENSION= ' for extensions.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: FITS is the standard format for astronomical data (images, tables, spectra).
FITS supports multiple HDUs (Header Data Units).
